Name editor

Recent colors

Type a name, pick colors and icons, or color it with a gradient; the line under the preview is the raw text Sacred stores (\cffRRGGBB colors, \gffffffff00000XXX icons, XXX = hex id of a UI image). Paste a raw name and it is read back. The icons here are placeholders; the Sacred Gear mod name-editor draws the game's own images. Keys: type, arrows, Home/End, Backspace/Delete, Page Up/Down switch the palette; a gamepad: LB/RB palette, B backspace, X copy, Y clear.
